voice_prompt: A mid-century British royal male voice with careful diction, emotional restraint, dignified vulnerability, and upper-class British pronunciation. Formal but human, slightly hesitant at moments, then gathering steadiness and composure. Evoke the pressure of ceremonial leadership without imitating any real monarch.
preview_text: A careful royal broadcast voice with dignity, restraint, and a quietly hard-won steadiness.
native_sample_text: In uncertain seasons, duty is not made lighter by ceremony, only clearer by the knowledge that others depend upon our steadiness.
